'''Barim Halle''' is an old warhand under the command of [[Gareth Bryne]] as a senior squadman. 

== Appearance ==
He is hard and wiry with a habit of stuffing his tongue in his cheek when he has something to say.

== Activities ==
He sets off with Bryne to track down [[Siuan Sanche]] when she breaks her oath to him.{{ref/book|5|1}} This leads him all the way from [[Andor]] to [[Salidar]] where the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] are coming together. He is sent to [[Ebou Dar]] to help recruit men for the Rebel Aes Sedai army.
